extensions.platform: Avalonia 12 XAML (Fluent), Windows desktop. Tokens live in src/UpdateManager.App/App.axaml (ThemeDictionaries Light/Dark + static stage brushes); font set in Program.cs. No CSS; snippets below are web approximations for the panel.

display.purpose: Selected release version number; one per screen.

headline.purpose: Featured recent project name; empty states «Первый проект» / «Первый выпуск».

title.purpose: Project name at the top of the catalog panel.

title-sm.purpose: Stage block titles, recent project names, primary button label.

body.purpose: Status line, metadata beside the version, table values.

detail.purpose: Paths, catalog second line, stage block detail.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked list headers in the left panel only.

states.name: recent-missing
states.purpose: Recent project whose folder no longer exists.

states.name: stage-failed-stroke
states.purpose: Only heavy stroke in the system; failed stage block and chip.

breakpoints.name: stage-strip-wrap
breakpoints.value: 150px min block width; below it the strip goes two per row

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled ink button that names the next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111111; color: #F4F4F2; font-family: 'Golos Text', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; padding: 11px 22px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.86; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.72; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2E86AB; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Hairline-outlined secondary action (table actions, alternatives beside the primary).
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: transparent; color: #111111; font-family: 'Golos Text', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid #C9C9C6; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: #D6D6D3; border-color: #8A8A87; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2E86AB; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:disabled { background: transparent; color: #8A8A87; border-color: #C9C9C6; }

components.name: Stage Strip
components.description: Signature component: one row of square stage blocks; fill = done, hairline = pending, red outline = failed.

components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; font-family: 'Golos Text', sans-serif; } .ds-stage { min-height: 112px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #8A8A87; color: #595957; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-stage b { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-stage span { font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-done { border: none; color: #111111; } .ds-failed { border: 2px solid #C8262B; color: #C8262B; }

components.name: Pending Stage Block
components.description: Stage not yet done: transparent with a 1px pending outline and muted words.
components.css: .ds-stage-pending { width: 180px; min-height: 112px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #8A8A87; color: #595957; font-family: 'Golos Text', sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-stage-pending b { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-stage-pending span { font-size: 12px; }

components.css: .ds-catalog { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 280px; background: #E5E5E3; font-family: 'Golos Text', sans-serif; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 11px 20px; border-top: 1px solid #C9C9C6; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover, .ds-selected { background: #D6D6D3; } .ds-ver { font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-line { font-size: 12px; color: #595957; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-left: 8px; } .ds-chips i { display: block; width: 14px; height: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-chip-pending { border: 1px solid #8A8A87; } .ds-chip-failed { border: 2px solid #C8262B; }

components.name: Version Heading
components.description: The one big number, with platform and release number beside it on the baseline.
components.css: .ds-heading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 20px; font-family: 'Golos Text', sans-serif; color: #111111; } .ds-display { font-size: 72px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; } .ds-meta { font-size: 14px; color: #595957; }

components.name: Info Table Row
components.description: Label / value / action row under a hairline.
components.css: .ds-info { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px 1fr 128px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 0; border-top: 1px solid #C9C9C6; font-family: 'Golos Text', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-k { color: #595957; } .ds-v { color: #111111; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; padding-right: 16px; } .ds-a { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #C9C9C6; border-radius: 0; padding: 5px 12px; font: inherit; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; } .ds-a:hover { background: #D6D6D3; border-color: #8A8A87; } .ds-a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2E86AB; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The world borrows from a record-label catalog sleeve (Saville / Factory): a matte ground, hairline rules, ink type, and colour that appears only as code. Every version of an application is a catalog entry. Its state is a strip of square stage blocks (Билд, Патч, Файлы, Доставка, Проверка) read left to right: filled means done, a hairline outline means not yet, a heavy red outline means failed. The strip is always spelled out in words beside or inside it, so colour is never the only carrier of meaning.

The surface is a tool, not a showcase. Density is calm: one oversized version number per screen, one row of stage blocks, one primary ink button that names the next step, and a quiet label/value/action table under a hairline. Everything else is neutral grey on matte ground. Light and dark themes are the same world with the values inverted; stage colours are identical in both because they are code, not decoration.

Scope as built: the main window (start screen and project screen) is the only surface drawn in this world. The other windows (project settings, delivery, FTP connection, FTP browser, operation log, message and prompt dialogs) still use the pre-redesign 1.x layout and only inherit the tokens (ground, hairline, square corners, Golos Text, Fluent accent). Their framed groups, `hint` opacity text and Consolas log are legacy, not rules of this system.
keyCharacteristics: Matte neutral ground, ink type, hairline rules; no gradients, no shadows, no rounded corners.
Colour exists only as the five stage hues; state is encoded as fill (done), outline (pending), red outline (failed).
One display-size version number is the only headline; metadata sits beside it on the baseline.
One filled ink button per screen; every other action is a hairline-outlined quiet button or a menu item.
Every coded state is also written in Russian words («№ 5 · проверка не прошла»).

rules.name: The Colour Is Code Rule
rules.body: The five stage hues and the failure red appear only on stage blocks and stage chips. Text, buttons, panels, rules and selection stay neutral.

rules.name: The Same Code In Both Themes Rule
rules.body: Stage hues and Stage Ink do not change between light and dark; only neutrals and Failure Red adapt.

rules.name: The Spelled-Out Rule
rules.body: Every stage state shown in colour is also present as words: the block title and detail, the catalog line («новый · патч не собран»), and the tooltip («Проверка: не прошла …»).

rules.name: The One Big Number Rule
rules.body: The version number is the only display-size text on the project screen; platform and release number sit beside it on the baseline in muted body text, never above it.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any text that is a version, date, number or count uses tabular figures so catalog columns and dates align.

rules.name: The Single Strip Rule
rules.body: Stages render as one strip per platform track; never as a dashboard of equal cards spread across the screen.

rules.name: The No Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow or floats. Hover and selection change fill (Selected Grey) or opacity, never elevation.

dos: Do keep colour exclusively on stage blocks and chips: fill for done, 1px Pending outline for not yet, 2px Failure Red outline for failed.
Do spell out every coded state in Russian words next to or inside the colour («№ 5 · проверка не прошла»).
Do use one Ink primary button per screen whose label names the next step; put every other action in quiet hairline buttons or the menu.
Do use square corners (0) and 1px hairlines on every new surface, including the legacy windows when they are redrawn.
Do use tabular figures for versions, dates and counts.
Do keep stage hues and Stage Ink identical in light and dark themes.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients or rounded corners.
Don't use stage hues for buttons, links, headings, selection or decoration.
Don't mark selection with coloured bars or accent strips; selection is a Selected Grey fill.
Don't lay stages out as a dashboard of equal cards or actions as a row of equal buttons.
Don't place small uppercase labels above the display number or headings; the tracked caps label is only a list header in the left panel.
